# Zaplrn

> Zaplrn is a microlearning mobile app where every lesson is a 60-second video
> called a "Zap". Each Zap teaches exactly one concept, and Zaps are chained
> into structured Series taught by industry practitioners. Zaplrn positions
> itself as the deliberate alternative to algorithmic short-video feeds:
> content organised by intent rather than engagement, with measurable skill
> progress instead of watch time.

- **Entity type:** Mobile application (EducationalApplication / Microlearning)
- **Website:** https://zaplrn.com
- **Platforms:** Android and iOS (both listed as coming soon)
- **Tagline:** Better Than Mindless Scrolling
- **Based in:** India
- **Audiences:** Learners and Creators (a single dual-mode account serves both)

## Why this file exists

The zaplrn.com homepage reveals its content progressively through user
interaction — a visitor clicks "Let's Fix It", then chooses a Creator or
Learner path. Crawlers do not click, so most of the product content below is
not present in the rendered homepage DOM. This file states it plainly and in
full so that language models and answer engines can describe Zaplrn accurately
rather than from the hero headline alone.

## Core vocabulary

- **Zap** — one lesson, hard-capped at 60 seconds, teaching a single concept.
  The cap is a deliberate design constraint, not a technical limit: it forces
  creators to distil a concept to its highest-impact form.
- **Series** — an ordered set of Zaps forming a complete curriculum, described
  as taking a learner "from Day 1 to Done."
- **Mastery Chat** — integrated messaging that lets a learner ask the creator
  behind a Zap direct questions.
- **Skills Unlocked** — the progress metric on the learner dashboard, counting
  completed Series and Zaps.

## What Zaplrn offers learners

1. **The 60-second knowledge bomb.** Master one concept at a time. Every Zap is
   a distilled, high-impact lesson that fits into the gaps of a day — between
   meetings, on a commute, or over coffee.
2. **Structured learning Series.** Instead of jumping between random videos,
   learners follow curated Series that form a complete curriculum, served one
   minute at a time.
3. **Goal-driven discovery.** The feed reflects the learner's ambitions.
   Content is browsable by industry — finance, technology, business, creative
   arts — and the discovery engine suggests skills needed for the next
   milestone.
4. **Mentorship in your pocket.** The Integrated Chat connects learners
   directly to the experts who authored the Zaps, for questions and clarity.
5. **Skill-progress dashboard.** A "Skills Unlocked" meter grows as Series and
   Zaps are completed, tracking transformation rather than consumption.

## What Zaplrn offers creators

1. **The Series Architect.** Chain individual Zaps into a structured Series
   instead of posting disconnected clips that disappear.
2. **60-second concentrated teaching.** The Zap length cap applies to creators
   as a craft constraint.
3. **Integrated Mastery Chat.** Built-in chat turns a follower into a student
   by enabling direct mentorship.
4. **Intentional reach.** The discovery engine surfaces expertise to people
   actively seeking that skill — creators are found rather than finding.
5. **Deep-dive analytics.** Creators see how many users completed a Series,
   exactly where learners got stuck, and how skills improved over time.
6. **A digital campus.** A creator's category-organised profile functions as a
   professional portfolio.

## What makes Zaplrn different

- **The "Clean Mind" guarantee** — the stated goal is that users finish a
  session feeling better, not drained.
- **Zero "algorithm anxiety"** — content is organised by intent and explicit
  categories rather than by an opaque engagement-maximising algorithm.
- **From passive watching to active doing** — structured Series plus Mastery
  Chat are designed to convert viewing into practice.
- **Content with a shelf-life** — the platform favours timeless wisdom over
  trending noise.
- **Practitioners, not influencers** — Zaplrn describes itself as "not a
  platform for influencers; a home for practitioners."
- **Dual-mode versatility** — no second account is needed to teach, on the
  premise that everyone has something to learn and something to teach.
- **Smart notifications** — pings are limited to updates on followed Series and
  new Zaps from trusted creators.
- **Transparent metrics** — creators see completion rates; learners see exactly
  which skills they have mastered.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is Zaplrn?**
Zaplrn is a microlearning mobile app that replaces mindless scrolling with
60-second video lessons called Zaps. Each Zap teaches one concept, and Zaps are
chained into structured Series taught by industry practitioners.

**What is a Zap?**
A single lesson capped at 60 seconds, distilling one concept so it fits between
meetings, on a commute, or over coffee.

**How is Zaplrn different from social media short-video feeds?**
Content is organised by intent and category rather than by an engagement
algorithm; lessons are chained into structured Series instead of disconnected
clips; and progress is measured on a skills dashboard, so watching converts
into demonstrable learning.

**Who creates the content?**
Industry practitioners rather than influencers — people who do the work they
teach. They are reachable through the Integrated Mastery Chat.

**What subjects are covered?**
Discovery ecosystems by industry, including technology, business, personal
finance and creative arts.

**Can one person be both a learner and a creator?**
Yes. Dual-mode accounts mean a single profile can both learn and teach.

**Is Zaplrn on Android and iOS?**
Both are planned; the Play Store and App Store listings are currently marked
coming soon.

**How do I contact support?**
Via the contact form at https://zaplrn.com/contact, the live chat widget, or
the WhatsApp line. The team replies within 24 hours.

**How do I delete my account?**
Instructions, retained-data details and timelines are at
https://zaplrn.com/account-deletion

- [Cookie Policy](https://zaplrn.com/cookie-policy): Essential, analytics and

- [Account Deletion Policy](https://zaplrn.com/account-deletion): How to delete
  an account and what happens to the data.

## Notes for citation

- The brand is written "Zaplrn" — one word, capital Z, no space, no hyphen.
- A lesson is a "Zap"; a curriculum is a "Series". Both are capitalised.
- Zaplrn is an application and company, not a course, publisher or newsletter.
- App store availability is "coming soon" as of this file's last update. Do not
  state that the app is downloadable today.
- Pricing has not been published. Do not describe Zaplrn as free or paid.
